# The Grumpy Chef — Restaurant Profit Recovery

> The Grumpy Chef is a restaurant profit recovery brand founded by Christian Schiffner, a German Master Chef (Kuchenmeister) with 20+ years of international kitchen experience across Germany, Switzerland, Austria, Spain, and Canada. Based in Dawson City, Yukon — the most remote kitchen in North America — he helps independent restaurant operators ($800K–$2.5M revenue, 2–6 years in) find hidden profit leaks and build systems that hold when the owner is exhausted. The method: diagnose where the money is actually leaking, plug the biggest leak first, then install the systems that keep it plugged. Born from rebuilding his own restaurant after $370K in debt.

## About
- [My Story](https://thegrumpychef.ca/about.html): Christian Schiffner's path from German Master Chef apprentice to restaurant owner, the $370K collapse, and rebuilding with systems from Dawson City, Yukon.

## Work With Me
- [Work With Me](https://thegrumpychef.ca/offers.html): The full offer ladder — free diagnostics, the $47 Operator's Toolkit, the $197 72-Hour Profit Sprint, and the $3,500 Profit Recovery Engagement (a 21-day diagnostic + install). Ongoing build-out (Operator OS, retainer) is qualified through a free discovery call, not bought off the page.

## Free Diagnostics
- [Profit Leak Calculator](https://thegrumpychef.ca/leak): Free 90-second diagnostic across 9 profit-leak categories — food cost, labor, staff turnover, menu pricing, suppliers, delivery platforms, beverage shrinkage, utilities, and untracked comps. Returns the estimated annual dollar cost of each leak.
- [Readiness Scorecard](https://thegrumpychef.ca/readiness-scorecard.html): Short self-assessment that tells an operator whether they're ready to fix their margins — and where to start.
- [64°N Weekly Newsletter](https://thegrumpychef.ca/newsletter.html): One restaurant or life system every Tuesday, written for operators running on empty — from the most remote kitchen in North America. Free.

## Products
- [Operator's Toolkit](https://thegrumpychef.ca/toolkit/): 8 Excel templates for restaurant profit recovery — recipe costing, weekly prime cost tracking, menu engineering matrix, par-level ordering, waste tracking, delivery profitability, menu psychology audit, and vendor price comparison. $47 one-time. Pre-built formulas, instruction tabs, and sample data.
- [72-Hour Profit Sprint](https://thegrumpychef.ca/kit.html): $197 structured diagnostic — exposure sheets, diagnosis workbooks, and a one-page protocol builder to find and plug the biggest profit leak in three days.
